facts.title: Japan and Indonesia — archipelagic states
facts.text: Japan and Indonesia are archipelagic states composed of many islands.

facts.title: Lesotho — enclave geography
facts.text: Lesotho is an independent state entirely surrounded by South Africa.

facts.title: San Marino and Vatican City — Italy enclaves
facts.text: San Marino and Vatican City are independent states surrounded by Italy.

facts.title: Baltic states — membership
facts.text: The Baltic states are Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.

facts.title: Asian Tigers — historic economic label
facts.text: South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Singapore are commonly termed the Asian Tigers in historical development literature.

facts.title: East Asian Miracle — historic scope
facts.text: The source’s East Asian Miracle grouping is retained only as a dated economic-development label, not a current ranking.

facts.title: Persian Gulf coastal states — source scope
facts.text: The scan lists eight Persian Gulf coastal states; this is retained as a bounded regional-reference list rather than a political-status claim.

facts.title: Balkan regional label — scope
facts.text: Balkan membership varies by geographic and historical definition; the scan’s country list is kept only as source-attributed regional reference.

facts.title: Caucasus — conventional country list
facts.text: Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Georgia are commonly grouped as the three South Caucasus countries.

facts.title: CIS — 1991 formation
facts.text: The Commonwealth of Independent States formally came into being on 21 December 1991.

facts.title: Seven Sisters — Indian state group
facts.text: India’s Seven Sisters are Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, and Tripura.

facts.title: Baltic states — European region
facts.text: The Baltic states form a northeastern European region on the eastern shores of the Baltic Sea.

notes.title: Narcotics and trafficking exclusion
notes.text: All Golden Triangle, Golden Crescent, Golden Wedge, production, cultivation, and trafficking assertions on this source page are withheld as security-sensitive material and are not turned into study facts or questions.

notes.title: Political-geography terminology boundary
notes.text: The source’s `perforated state` label is not treated as a universal classification. Enclave facts are retained in direct geographic wording instead.

notes.title: Economic-label boundary
notes.text: Three Tigers, Four Tigers, Super Seven, and East Asian Miracle are historically contingent economic labels. They are not used as current performance claims.

notes.title: Territorial-conflict boundary
notes.text: Nagorno-Karabakh control, recognition, and conflict wording is withheld. No territorial or conflict narrative from the scan is imported as a current fact.

notes.title: Printed-MCQ quality gate
notes.text: Only four complete source-keyed questions with readable options, visually confirmed keys, and independently supported neutral historic/geographic premises are retained. All security, narcotics, ranking, and ambiguous regional-definition questions are withheld.
